review_text: This Dunkin' branch has good AC, pleasantly low-volume music, and most importantly, a comfort room. I don't know why, but I really like this one, probably because it feels more organized than other branches. Just my personal preference, no shade intended. ✌🏽 Parking space is limited.

My go to breakfast spot. Their coffee is now much better and pairs perfectly with their choco butternut or bunwich, which comes in tuna, and ham and cheese. As of writing, they have their own new comfort room. It's a significant improvement from four months ago when they did not have a designated comfort room and had to go to the back restaurant to use the CR. You can relax in the open space on the second floor and enjoy the fresh air.

I wanted to claim my coupon from the recent TXT concert and when I asked them if they had the custom TXT box with them printed on it, they mislead me into thinking they had it and laughed at me for it by saying na there wasn't a box like that. I actually thought there wasn't a custom box like that but turns out there was. They could've just told me they didn't have a box but instead they made a fool out of me. Not only that, their air conditioner was leaking and causing a puddle on the ground. That could cause someone to slip and get hurt. This was probably one of the most irritating experiences I've ever had with employees.
Good place to stay late night. Lots of chairs and parking space. Friendly staff

Disrespectful employees. Ordered there and got my mocha latte and they served me a wrong one. Complained about it they only said that it was mocha even though it's not I know what the color looks like however the color that was served to us was Spanish latte they even mocked us they mentioned that maybe it's too strong for us because they said that they got a lot of complaints about it. I love Dunkin however every time I order here in this specific branch they always get my order incorrectly. Also ordered here on time with a thousand and then told the employee I don't have smaller amount, the employee was upset and threw the 10peso coin on the counter with the paper bills.

Of all the times I've ordered, about 50% of the time, the staff gets it wrong and packs the wrong donut(s). They got the order wrong, again. This time, it's supposed to be Vietnamese Coffee they gave a regular coffee. They even repeat my order to check if they recorded correctly. But got it wrong still.
Place is perfect. However, security guards have no sense of common courtesy for their customers.
only availed to go. but donuts remain delicious with the classic dunkin taste.
